archetypes.name: dyn-default-search
archetypes.rationale: Default and explicit search paths now diverge and need close behavior review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /learn-from-bugs prepare filtering path. Check that implicit default searches filter only normalized bug titles, while explicit --search and verbal-description paths remain unfiltered. Pay special attention to the skill prompt variables and argv-based search_explicit detection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
